title: A report, from request to delivery
lede: Follow 32 messages across six participants, from queued work to a completed download.

nodes.label: Browser
nodes.detail: Requests the report and downloads the resulting file.

nodes.label: Application
nodes.detail: Records report requests and exposes their status.

nodes.label: Job queue
nodes.detail: Hands accepted jobs to a worker.

nodes.label: Worker
nodes.detail: Builds and verifies an illustrative report artifact.

nodes.label: Object store
nodes.detail: Holds source objects and generated artifacts.

edges.label: Request a report
edges.detail: The person submits report options to the application.

edges.label: Validate options
edges.detail: The application checks the requested options before creating work.

edges.label: Enqueue report job
edges.detail: The application places the illustrative report job on the queue.

edges.label: Job accepted
edges.detail: The queue returns the accepted job reference.

edges.label: Return job reference
edges.detail: The application returns a reference that the browser can use to check status.

edges.label: Claim next job
edges.detail: The worker asks the queue for available work.

edges.label: Job parameters
edges.detail: The queue delivers the job parameters to the worker.

edges.label: Mark running
edges.detail: The worker asks the application to record that report generation has started.

edges.label: Running status saved
edges.detail: The application confirms the running status was recorded.

edges.label: Read source objects
edges.detail: The worker requests the source objects needed for the report.

edges.label: Source objects
edges.detail: The object store returns the illustrative input records.

edges.label: Normalize records
edges.detail: The worker normalizes the records into the chosen report structure.

edges.label: Build report rows
edges.detail: The worker builds the rows that will appear in the report.

edges.label: Write draft artifact
edges.detail: The worker writes an intermediate artifact to storage.

edges.label: Draft stored
edges.detail: The store confirms the draft artifact was saved.

edges.label: Verify artifact
edges.detail: The worker checks that the generated artifact matches the requested structure.

edges.label: Publish final artifact
edges.detail: The worker writes the verified final artifact.

edges.label: Artifact reference
edges.detail: The store returns the final artifact reference.

edges.label: Mark report ready
edges.detail: The worker provides the final artifact reference and asks the application to record readiness.

edges.label: Acknowledge job
edges.detail: The worker acknowledges the completed job to the queue.

edges.label: Acknowledged
edges.detail: The queue confirms that the acknowledgment was received.

edges.label: Request notification
edges.detail: The application asks the notifier to deliver a completion notice.

edges.label: Notice accepted
edges.detail: The notifier confirms acceptance of the notification request.

edges.label: Report ready notice
edges.detail: The notifier sends an illustrative asynchronous completion notice to the browser.

edges.label: Check report status
edges.detail: The browser asks the application for the recorded report status.

edges.label: Ready status
edges.detail: The application returns the ready status.

edges.label: Request download
edges.detail: The browser asks for the location of the finished report.

edges.label: Locate final artifact
edges.detail: The application looks up the final artifact location.

edges.label: Download location
edges.detail: The store returns the illustrative download location.

edges.label: Return location
edges.detail: The application returns the download location to the browser.

edges.label: Download report
edges.detail: The browser requests the report from the object store.

edges.label: Report file
edges.detail: The store returns the finished report file to the browser.

assumptions: Illustrative successful report-generation model; no application implementation was supplied.
Messages are ordered for explanation. Notification transport, authentication, retries, failures and concurrent jobs are outside this example.
The report-ready notice is an asynchronous signal. Dashed open arrows represent returns; self-calls explain local work.
Focused sequence notation: no activation bars or combined fragments. The page describes a model and does not execute a job.
evidence: Evidence: illustrative long-sequence example for layout and playback review; no application repository was supplied.
